question: Is the 26 November 2020 GR on the computer qualification certificate in force?
gold_answer: No. Stayed until further orders by the GR of 27-11-2020, which reinstated the orders under the 20-11-2018 letter

gold_grs_detail.title: Decision regarding final date for submission of compulsory computer qualification certificate and recovery of excess payment.

product.answer: The 26-11-2020 GR on the computer qualification certificate is stayed by the 27-11-2020 GR, which puts it on hold till further orders and restores the 20-11-2018 letter orders. Therefore, it is not currently in force.
